# Independent test-integrity review

Reviewed `../static-registrations-v1.patch` SHA-256 `aa65a0cf95904fc8603079f0cf0321b722e58bd614aa39f45662d3b0074a08eb` and `../manifest-v1.json` SHA-256 `053d7c62ebda47c4c16b67d47ad6aeeb85c54f1d55edc9ddb12b7743c2c821d0`, against canonical source `1bebeb934f5aee90e29a002f097e610ce6b4cdda`. No canonical writes or remote operations.

No blocking finding in the bounded review. Patch touches only menu, radio, and progress-bar specs. It relocates newer suites to preserve historical index order and turns opaque registration loops into static cases calling the same bodies; radio's two new identical names become distinct while both host inputs remain. Inspection of the extracted body transformations and independent TypeScript AST comparison of all `expect(...)` expressions found equal multisets: menu 405, radio 206, progress 58. This comparison alone cannot prove semantic equivalence; the code and helper arguments were also inspected.

Independently derived the candidate roster using isolated copies of scripts and fixture source: 2,315 cases, 2,315 distinct IDs, 57 inventory paths; exact case records matched the frozen candidate roster. All 2,292 IDs and names from the comparison baseline were preserved, and the 54 other inventory paths were byte-identical to commit `782197ecc`. The three baseline files match `782197ecc` except the menu's one opaque backdrop loop, normalized only in the comparison to four same-order same-name static helper calls; the original baseline failure is retained and a direct untouched-baseline static roster was not available. Four duplicate names predate the proposal and were preserved; unique IDs are path/index based.

Re-ran synthetic positive and all five discovery negatives, plus duplicate observation rejection; all behaved as reported. Verified report hashes, copied-artifact SHA `2cf96975b6f6adaa83a8bf42f99a756f34bbdd7166ea899120f5605c66f8bffb`, and all-pass totals 176/99/31 for menu/radio/progress. Their non-control reporter sequences exactly match corresponding derived roster names in order (174/97/29). These are author-produced copied-artifact reports, not independent browser reruns or a current-HEAD pack.

Strict application succeeded to current source, followed by ARIA patch `../../radio-aria-eba6/radio-aria-fix.patch`, SHA-256 `ec6e838c8083b6086c2b9e889073e35c8fec25d97a70b7adde0707988353030d`. Re-derivation of combined source yielded 2,316 unique IDs across 57 paths and no changed pre-existing ID/name. Combined type check was not run. Source binding refresh, full artifact suite, and independent browser execution remain outside this review.
